# Scraper test fixtures

Place saved HTML fixture files here for offline parser tests.

- `sample_product.html` — a raw product page from caprioptics.com saved for `test_parser.py::TestHtmlParser::test_parses_fixture_if_present`.

These files are excluded from `.gitignore` under `apps/scraper/fixtures/` to avoid committing supplier HTML. Add them manually for local development.
